# dist - release packages

Generated by `packaging/make_dist.sh`; `build-all.sh` refreshes a
camera's package as soon as it rebuilds it. Everything here is output -
delete the lot and it comes back.

One directory per camera. Each holds the card tree as a zip, the three
card-flashing scripts, a READ_ME_FIRST, loose
`vers.req`/`ver.req` for the firmware check, and SHA256SUMS.txt.

it - put your own `.gb`/`.gbc` files there.
